subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 9: introduces /p/ (path, pencil, map, clap); rhyming words (pat, sat, tap); differentiates s and p; segments and blends words

show.line: Listen. p, p, pencil. p, p, path! Pencil starts with p.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with p, as in pencil?
Say the sound with me. p, as in pencil!
Is it s or p? Listen. Path.
Listen. m, a, p. What word is it?
Does it start with p or s? Sort the pictures.

hints: Put your lips together and pop! p, p, p.
Rhyming words sound the same at the end. Pat, sat.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that rhymes with tap.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Pot does not rhyme with tap. Map rhymes with tap.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Tap, map. They sound the same at the end!

parent_line: Can hear the p sound, blend words like map and find words that rhyme.
